_note: Config for scripts/build_metaqa_eval_set.py: the exp-039 MetaQA evaluation set (ADR 0045). 250 questions per hop, one seeded draw from the official vanilla MetaQA test split. n_per_hop is the exp-039 Phase A power analysis (exact McNemar, 80% power, discordance 0.20, effect 0.10, Holm m=6 -> 250). The legacy v1 set (first 100 lines of each test file, datasets.metaqa_questions_template) stays as a separate set.

source._note: Public mirror of the official MetaQA release (https://github.com/yuyuz/MetaQA; its Google Drive folder refused automated download, HTTP 401, 2026-11-27). Accepted because (a) the three qa_test.txt line counts equal the official README's 9,947 / 14,872 / 14,274 exactly, (b) the mirror's kb/kb.txt is byte-identical (sha256 9b4d3b30...) to the v1 kb.txt this repo already uses, and (c) the first 100 lines of each mirror test file reproduce the v1 refined_{h}hop.txt questions and answers_{h}hop.txt answers exactly (100/100 per hop).
